verdict.rationale: Ashby's ATS page claims recruiters can design their own recruiting process, and the Assistant docs refer to candidates' current stage in a role's pipeline. That gives thin first-party support for configurable pipelines, but nothing in the pack describes per-job custom stages, drag-to-move, or bulk actions. missing for 10: documented custom stages per job, drag-and-drop candidate movement, bulk actions across the pipeline, hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a recruiter, I run configurable hiring pipelines — custom stages per job, drag-to-move candidates, and bulk actions across the whole pipeline

citations.quote: Design and develop your perfect recruiting process.
you can ask for a pipeline update on an open Product Engineer role that includes candidate sentiment, current stage, and concerns raised in interviews
